sources.name: RoboPoint synthetic subsets
sources.partition: Only object_ref/ and region_ref/ synthetic examples from the released mix
sources.skills: Object pointing, spatial referring and free-space placement points.
sources.status: Public release verified; 3 coordinate-target annotation records parsed. Image archives, overlap audit and task adapter pending.
sources.audit: Exclude all other namespaces in the mixed release. Sampled valid points do not by themselves define a complete valid-region RL reward.

sources.name: Open Images training split
sources.partition: Official train annotations and their matching train images only
sources.skills: Bounding-box grounding, object/mask pointing, sets and counting after annotation-quality filtering.
sources.status: Official train boxes verified; 5 bounding-box annotation rows parsed. Images, masks, holdout deduplication and task adapter pending.
sources.audit: Filter incomplete/group annotations for counting. Compare source IDs, image hashes and near-duplicates against protected benchmark images before admission.

sources.name: SpatialRGPT / Open Spatial Dataset
sources.partition: Published training annotations; Open Images source photographs
sources.skills: Region-grounded spatial relation and geometric question answering.
sources.status: Public annotation release and pinned revision verified. Full download, image matching, overlap audit and task adapter pending.
sources.audit: Shares Open Images provenance; group splits by source image and deduplicate across mixtures. Estimated geometry is not simulator ground truth.

sources.name: SAT-v2 training split
sources.partition: train only; exclude released test data
sources.skills: Spatial relations, counting, viewpoint and motion reasoning.
sources.status: Public release verified, including 11 train Parquet shards. Row API returned 503; local row/image staging and task adapter pending.
sources.audit: Group by source scene and image identity, including alternate views. Do not equate offline viewpoint QA with a closed-loop active-perception task.

sources.name: CLEVRER training split
sources.partition: Official training videos, annotations, questions and answers only
sources.skills: Temporal, causal, predictive and counterfactual physical reasoning.
sources.status: Official training release links verified. Video staging, scene audit and task adapter pending.
sources.audit: Keep all questions and video frames from the same scene in one partition. Exclude validation and test releases from training.

rules: Preserve every named reasoning benchmark as evaluation-only, including all RefCOCO variants, RefSpatial and PixMo-Points.
Dataset training partitions do not automatically prove separation from independently named evaluation datasets. Audit source scenes, assets and images.
Released annotations are not automatically a faithful RL verifier. Validate ambiguity, multiple valid answers and reward behavior before admission.
Use existing training releases first; generate new scenes for coverage or verifier gaps.

deferred_sources.name: CLEVR-Ref+
deferred_sources.status: Published box/mask referring dataset exists; original download URL returned HTTP 404 in the current probe. Not relied on for immediate data preparation.
